change_summary: Clinician review draft: reproduce the two simplified legacy calculations and overall categorization while removing unsupported Framingham and ASCVD branding. Named HTML controls and scored choices are preserved; aggregate counts/sign groups are derived from typed responses. Assign every field to its declared form section. Supersedes engineering review.1; remains unapproved. Complete HTML field and option coverage; preserve radio and multiline controls. Supersedes engineering review.2.

definition.title: Legacy Cardiac Risk Estimate (Unvalidated)
definition.description: Reproduces two simplified local formulas for comparison and retirement review. These outputs are not validated Framingham or ASCVD scores.
exclusions: Not for diagnosis, treatment thresholds, prescribing, or prevention decisions.

warnings.text: These are unvalidated legacy estimates, not Framingham or ASCVD results. Use an approved calculator and current guideline.
